summary: Returning after a sore throat, Couch Investor recaps news on Nebius, Palantir, Meta, Google, and Amazon. He takes credit for his July 2 post predicting a Nebius-Palantir tie-up, now announced: Palantir names Nebius its preferred sovereign AI infrastructure partner, bringing Nebius compute inside the Palantir perimeter — a deal he thinks will drive very big 2027 ARR numbers. Neoclouds rallied: Nebius +7.7%, CoreWeave +11%. His core segment is a revenue-per-employee comparison across big tech via fiscal.ai: Meta's efficiency has accelerated since 2022; Apple's is flat (but extremely profitable); Amazon's inflected up after 2021-22 and should keep rising; Uber's is up ~50% since 2022. On the Tesla-vs-Uber debate, he argues autonomy becomes a commodity and no one can displace Uber's network — fleet owners will put cars on Uber for utilization. Google is again 'disrespected': under its 200-day moving average, forward P/E 24.7, a half-trillion-dollar backlog, and accelerating Google Cloud; selling 2027 puts at current prices pays attractive premiums. Meta's Muse is the bigger story — 100M free tokens per week plus cheap subscription tiers — a power move to crush competition and build a take-rate business on hundreds of billions in commerce, subsidized by Meta's insanely profitable core. Macro (Fed policy, oil) still drives moves; earnings season is nearly done. Calls: GOOGL BUY; META BUY; AMZN BUY.
